description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tools for DeepSeek Harness. Runs open text-to-image models (SDXL families, FLUX.2, Animagine, Anima and others) on Kaggle GPU kernels, provides a full-page studio UI and chat-callable agent tools, and saves generated images to the local workspace.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文生图工作台与 Agent 工具：在 Kaggle GPU 上运行 SDXL 系列、FLUX.2、Animagine、Anima 等开源文生图模型，提供整页工作台与对话调用能力，生成的图片保存到本地工作区。
